utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon to all. The hearing -- the court is in session. Madam Registrar, could you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-98-32/1-A, the Prosecutor versus Milan Lukic and Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Milan Lukic, can you hear the proceeding in a language you can understand? THE APPELLANT M. LUKIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour, I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Sredoje Lukic, can you hear and follow the hearing in a language that you understand? THE APPELLANT S. LUKIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour, I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. May we please have the appearances, and we shall start by the representative of the OTP, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. GILLETT
utterances.text: Your Honour, my name is Matthew Gillett, appearing with Mr. Kyle Wood and Mr. Colin Nawrot, our case manager, on behalf of the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you. [Interpretation] Thank you. Let me now turn to the Defence. Could I have appearances for the Defence of Mr. Milan Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. The Defence of Milan Lukic. For the Defence of Milan Lukic, Tomislav Visnjic, attorney; and Dragan Ivetic, my colleague who is a co-counsel; and we also have Dalida Chrysostomidou and Anatoly Vlasov as our legal assistants.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] Very well. And now could I have appearances for the counsel of Mr. Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. I am Djuro Cepic, Defence counsel for Mr. Sredoje Lukic. Appearing with me, co-counsel Mr. Jens Dieckmann, on my left-hand side; and behind me, our assistants, Ms. Lucy Clayton, behind me, as intern in our Defence team; and on the left side, Ms. Sabine Schulz as our legal assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: I note that Ms. Dalida Chrysostomidou -- [Interpretation] I apologise, I did not pronounce this name correctly as well as Anatoly Vlasov -- [In English] Both legal assistants will join Mr. Ivetic. [Interpretation] And I also note that Mrs. Lucy Clayton as well as Sabine Schulz -- [In English] will join Mr. Cepic as the lead counsel. [Interpretation] This pre-appeals conference was organised in application to Rule 65 bis (B) and (C) of the Rules in this Tribunal which require for a pre-appeals conference to be organised within 120 days after the notice of appeal was filed and then every 120 days after the previous pre-appeals conference. The main purpose of a pre-appeals conference is to give the opportunity to any person detained while waiting for an appeals judgement to -- the possibility of raising important questions, including questions dealing with the person's mental and physical health. We're meeting today for the first time. Let me remind you that the Trial Chamber has rendered a judgement in this case on January [as interpreted] 20th, 2009. I also would like to remind you that the OTP filed its notice of appeal on August 19, 2009, regarding Sredoje Lukic. Milan Lukic's Defence as well as Sredoje Lukic's Defence also filed their respective notice of appeals on August 19, 2009. I will now talk about the schedule regarding the filing of submissions for appeals. The OTP filed its public appeal brief on November 2nd, 2009, against Sredoje Lukic. Sredoje Lukic's Defence can file its appellee brief within 40 days after the filing of the Prosecution's brief. Sredoje Lukic also filed its appeal brief on November 2nd, in two copies, one public and redacted and one confidential, on November 2nd, 2009. The Prosecutor will have 40 days to produce the appellee brief. Furthermore, I would like to remind you that according to the decision rendered on October 30th, 2009, the Appeals Chamber gave Milan Lukic's Defence an extension of dead-line to file its appeal brief until December 17th, 2009. The Prosecutor will also have an extension of dead-line to file its appellee brief until February 5th, 2010. I would now like to address the detention conditions and the health of Mr. Milan Lukic and Mr. Sredoje Lukic. Do you have any problems regarding your detention condition or your health. THE APPELLANT M. LUKIC: [Interpretation] As far as I am concerned, I am very healthy. The conditions are normal, within the Detention Unit I mean.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: I'm glad to hear that. [Interpretation] Same question for Mr. Sredoje Lukic. THE APPELLANT S. LUKIC: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. There is nothing I can add. Everything is fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] The Appeals Chamber has been seized of an OTP pending motion of October 12th, 2009, in which the Appeals Chamber is asked to review and to cancel the order to disclose confidential information to Mr. Radovan Karadzic. The Appeals Chamber will render its decision in due time. When all written submissions will be filed, the Trial Chamber will decide then how to carry on and will set the date for the appeals hearing, but it is too early as of now to set this date because all written submissions must be filed. However, as things stand now regarding the submissions, the hearing will probably be organised during the spring of 2010. I would now like to ask the parties whether at this juncture they have any questions they would like to raise during this Status Conference. Before asking the representative of the OTP, I would like to say the following: The Appeals Chamber have already decided that next week -- [In English] They will file a motion to amend notice of appeal, except that I would like to know if you have anything else which you want to submit at this stage. [Interpretation] Could I have first the OTP, do you have anything to add?

utterances.speaker: MR. GILLETT
utterances.text: We have no further issues, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. And I now turn to the Defence of Mr. Sredoje Lukic. Do you have any issues to raise at this juncture?

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Nothing to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And what about the -- the Defence of Milan Lukic told us that they intended to file a motion to amend their notice of appeal. So I thank you all. I have no other items on the agenda as far as I'm concerned, and I believe that we can adjourn. I thank all parties for their participation as well as all those in and out of this courtroom for their help. The hearing stands adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: adjourned at 2.28 p.m.
